en:
Tsk, damn pests...! Why the hell
do I have to play nice and
explore ruins with a bunch of
Federation lackeys...!
*Sigh*, we discussed this\nseveral times before the\nexploration began.

While the hull of this ship belongs to
the Federation, it is crewed by people
from a vast variety of organizations,
making it a distinct entity from the
Federation military.
I believe it is only prudent for\neveryone to cooperate to\nachieve their respective goals.
That still doesn't mean I owe\nyou lot any cooperation!
Huh? Is Pavine not coming? I\nwas looking forward to\nexploring together, mya...
Ugh...
J-just this once! You damn\npests!
Yay! Let's go, mya!
Pavine is surprisingly kind to\nchildren, despite everything.\nHe's quite the caretaker.

Yes, it seems he occasionally
lets Relia and the others drag
him into games of
hide-and-seek on the ship.
Mirage, Captain, hurry up, hurry\nup!
Myamyam!?
Myaaaaaaaaaaa!
Whoa!
...Phew, I finally got out.
Hm? But why did the door\nsuddenly open, mya?
Um, by any chance, are you...?
What?
M... Myaaaa!!
Ah! This is the memory of when\nI first met Edge, mya!
I thought the people from the\nlab found me, so I ran away.\nAnd then, after that...
Wawa! Don't come over here,\nmya!
Myaaaaaaa!
Leave this to us and get back!

Edge was so cool back then. He just
swooped in right in front of me, just as
I was about to be eaten by those
experimental creatures...
Tsk. You Earthlings have a real\nknack for disregarding the\nprotection of primitive planets.

The Captain is right! Edge just
saved me because I was
captured!! He didn't do
anything wrong!

You're flaunting weapons created by
advanced civilization technology on a
planet with an obviously lower level of
civilization.
Human lives were being\nthreatened. I believe the use of\nweapons was unavoidable.

Furthermore, the Primitive
Planet Protection Treaty didn't
even exist in Edge's time, so he
didn't break any rules.
Hmph. Nothing but excuses\nfrom you pests.

Do you think I don't know how
this ended? You were tricked
by the director here, and
things went south fast, hehehe.
He had no choice!! Edge\nthought he could protect the\nDoctor's Earth!!
And instead, he drove it\nstraight to ruin. How touching.

Even without a treaty, any idiot could
figure that out. What happens when
you hand antimatter over to ignorant
fools?
...S-still, at that time... Edge...
Indeed. Mr. Pavine, surely you\nunderstand better than anyone\nthat arguing here is pointless?
Besides, I doubt you truly wish\nto cause such sadness to a\nyoung child.
Tsk...
Ms. Meracle, are you alright?
Yeah...
Captain, I recommend we abort\nthis exploration and return for\nnow. What do you think?
No, let's keep exploring.\nCaptain, Mirage, I'm okay!\nThank you!
Hey, Pavine. Why do you have\nto say such mean things about\neveryone?
Huh? It's obvious. Because\nthose Federation bastards are\nnothing but scum.
What?!

If the Federation is involved, I don't
care what it takes, you pieces of shit!
This is your last warning, you idiots.
Hand over Relia!
Why is there a starship in this\nsector...?
How far are you planning to\ntake this?! This is a CFNZ\nviolation!

Deploying a starship above an
undeveloped planet... That is a massive
violation of the Undeveloped Planet
Protection Treaty.
They're the ones who violated\nit first!
Dammit! You idiots, hurry up\nand capture Relia!
Aaaaaah!!
Crap! Dammit!!
Chronos Soldier: Shall I report\nthis to the General?

Don't you dare speak out of
turn, you insect! More
importantly, she might still be
nearby! Find her at all costs!!
Brother Pavi, we've got a\nproblem!

How could things possibly get
any worse, you insect?! And
stop calling me that while we're
in the army!
Ah, right, sorry, Brother Pavi!\n...Oh.
Enough! Now, what happened?

It looks like one of the Phase
Guns we provided to the leader
of the Eitalon was stolen by a
resident of this planet!
What!?

We found out it was stolen by some
strange woman claiming to be an
inventor in a town called Meedock, but
she seems to have no intention of
giving it back, no matter what I say.
I think if we sneak into her\nhouse in the middle of the\nnight, we could take it back...

Stop it, you idiot! That woman is a
civilian with nothing to do with this
affair! Do you intend to act just like
those Federation scum!?
Brother Pavi...
...I'll provide the Fol. Negotiate\nto buy it back at a high price.

Tsk, I was against providing our
weapons to those low-life
Eitalon thieves from the very
start...!
Yeah. They've even been\nattacking villages that have\nnothing to do with our orders...

Just get to the negotiations
now! If they try to dismantle it
the wrong way, they could blow
the whole town sky-high!

You're surprisingly
humanitarian, considering you
attacked the royal capital with
a starship.

There's a difference between those
who arm themselves and prepare for
battle, and civilians who don't. Do you
not understand that, you idiot?
You seemed really close with\nHal. Are you friends?

He's just some neighborhood brat.
Since we're from the same planet, I was
forced to look after him even after I
joined the military.
I know what that is! You're\nchildhood friends! Just like\nEdge and Reimi-mya!
Stop saying it in such a creepy\nway, you idiot! We just happen\nto be from the same planet.
Though, that planet is no\nlonger part of Kronos...
It was cast aside. By the damn\nKronos government.

Because it was on the frontier, people
dissatisfied with the treaty with the
Federation gathered there and
launched a massive rebellion against
the Kronos government.

The Kronos government struggled to
suppress it, and the Federation military
intervened under the guise of helping.
By the time anyone noticed, the planet
was under their control.
Now it's just a playground for those\nFederation military rejects to vent their\nfrustrations―a regular carnival of crime.
That's horrible...

That's why I bet everything on her...
General Alma. I know she's the only one
who can wipe those Federation fools
off the map!

This is the path I've chosen! I'll
eliminate anyone who gets in
her way, by any means
necessary.
Even if it means violating the\nUncharted Planet Protection\nTreaty!
If it's Kronos, does that mean\nPavine's home planet is in\nSector Kappa?

No, Iota. Its coordinates were
relatively close to Faykreed
and the Federation's 5th Deep
Space Base.
Which means...
This kid?
Yes, Cliff. They're quite weak,\nbut it looks like their life isn't in\ndanger.
A Terran.
It seems so.

Based on the analysis of the escape
pod's data, I believe they are a victim
of the engagement with Ardion at
Federation Space Base 17 the other
day.
So this brat is another victim\nof the war...

Yes. In our time, the Federation
was in a state of prolonged
war with an organization called
the Ardion Empire.
It's not uncommon to find\nescape pods of civilians caught\nup in the war while traveling.
This girl... she looks like\nsomeone...
It's Maria. This is a memory\nfrom seven years ago, so Cliff\nand I look younger, right?
Se-seven years ago!? But\nMirage and Cliff look exactly\nthe same to me, nya...
I'll take that as a compliment.

Hundreds of years later and the
Federation is still obsessed with power
struggles... In the end, it's always the
civilians who suffer. Damn pests...

Poor kid. She's so small. The
Federation and Ardion should
keep their power struggles to
themselves.
It's always the ordinary people\nwho get caught in the\ncrossfire.
...Is that why you started this\norganization?
It ain't that noble. I just hate\nfollowing things I don't like.
You don't have to be shy. ...At\nleast not with me.
I'll punch you.
Hehe...
...Sorry, but can I leave this kid\nin your care?
I understand, Cliff.
You're reading that email again,\naren't you?
Oh, Mirage. Don't sneak up on\nme. Is the kid doing okay?
Yes, their vitals are stable. In\nthe meantime, I thought I'd\nrecalculate our course.
Recalculate the course?

We can't just fly around dangerous
sectors with the child on board. I'll
search for the shortest, safest route
back to Claustro.
That's fine, right, Cliff?
Yeah, go for it. Sorry, Mirage. I\nhadn't even thought that far\nahead.
I figured you'd be too\npreoccupied reading that email\nto focus on anything else.
You've got me figured out,\nhuh?
An expose on the reality of Sector Iota\nand the lawless zone created by the\nFederation. Our first job begins.
Sector Iota! Do you know\nwhat's going to happen to my\nhome planet?!

Sector Iota is a vast region, so
I am not certain if this refers
specifically to your home
planet, Pavine.

However, Quark once accepted a
request from people in that region who
desired independence from the
Federation and filed a lawsuit regarding
their autonomy.
...And how did that turn out?
Unfortunately...
Hah, figures. There's no way\nthe Federation would just let\nsomething like that slide.
Why not?! All they want is to\ndecide things for themselves!

...If they allow even one exception, it
creates another. If a planet that's a
strategically important military base
asks for autonomy, it'll be a disaster.
The trial has ended, but we at\nQuark do not believe the\nmatter is settled.

If victory is difficult for
individuals, we will link those
forces together to win
complete autonomy.
That is the current approach\nof Quark, learned from that\nlost case.

So your plan is that if those wanting
independence gather not just on one
planet, but across entire star systems,
they can actually stand up to the
Federation?

Yes. We have already
successfully achieved
independence in several star
systems.
That's amazing, mya! Since\nMirage is from 200 years in\nthe future...

It might be hard to save Pavine's
friends right now, but their
great-great-great-grandchildren are
living happily, mya!

Starting a war only brings suffering to
innocent civilians. That is why we
resolve things through the law. This is
the path we have chosen.
Hmph... You trying to tell me\nthat the future isn't a total lost\ncause?
Is that not allowed?
Hmph. Everyone has their own\nway of living. Do as you please.
Actually, the person who\ncontacted us from Sector Iota\ngoes by the name Oakville...

Ah, but this is a story of a
future you have yet to see.
Please forget I mentioned it,
Captain.

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
